scope: Fudan SSDPP official course/teacher target roster: 296 course codes (2025 autumn and 2026 spring), 143 unique instructors.
method: Public web index only, not Edge-authenticated site search. Each instructor was queried individually with 复旦 + exact official roster name + (课评 OR 课堂 OR 选课 OR 课程评价); queries were submitted four per search call and grouped across Zhihu, WeChat article and Xiaohongshu domains. Combined response links are batch-level; association with any individual teacher is unconfirmed. Search snippets were not retained or treated as full text.

platform_findings.zhihu: returned candidate URLs; many unrelated/general pages; not yet article-level classroom-review hits
platform_findings.xiaohongshu: some indexed pages, mainly platform/vendor/admin or unrelated pages; no validated course-review hit
platform_findings.wechat: no direct mp.weixin.qq.com URL in captured teacher-query links; this records index output only, not absence of in-platform content
